meta.title: FEAT-003 · Change password
meta.subtitle: Design solution from technical-design.md: the components this slice changes, the contract on every arrow, and the decisions behind them. Pick a flow to follow one use-case path; click any arrow for its data contract.
meta.description: A signed-in user submits the current and a new password on the storefront. The gateway relays PUT /v1/me/password to Identity with the bearer token. Identity checks the current password and the policy, then in one transaction stores the new argon2id hash, revokes every OpenIddict authorization of the user except the current one, and writes PasswordChanged to the outbox. It reissues the hs.idp cookie with the new password stamp. The SPA then forces a session refresh, which spends the pre-change refresh token. Other sessions fail their next refresh and their old hs.idp cookie no longer signs them in. Notification sends the password-changed email.
overview: FR-AUTH-024, FR-AUTH-025, FR-AUTH-003 p, FR-NOTIF-014, NFR-SEC-015
PUT /v1/me/password, event PasswordChanged, hs.idp pwd_at stamp

nodes.label: Browser A
nodes.desc: The signed-in user changing the password. Holds the encrypted hs.bff cookie and the Identity hs.idp cookie; never a token.

nodes.label: Session B
nodes.desc: Any other authorization of the same user: another browser, or the seller centre in the same browser (its own OIDC client, ADR-0027). Signed out after the change.

nodes.label: Storefront SPA
nodes.desc: features/profile/ChangePasswordPage.vue (SCR-STF-018), api.ts changePassword. After 204: ProfileSession.refresh(), clear form, toast. 401 → markSignedOut(); 409 shows the message. Button disabled while in flight. PasswordField and rules move to packages/ (D-6).

nodes.label: Gateway + BFF
nodes.desc: Existing route /v1/me/{**rest} → identity (authenticated), CSRF X-HS-CSRF: 1, POST /bff/session/refresh (FEAT-002). Strips only hs.bff*, so hs.idp reaches Identity. A failed refresh clears the session cookie.

nodes.label: Identity
nodes.desc: PUT /v1/me/password in MeEndpoints (bearer, policy me). ChangeMyPasswordHandler collects every violation, then hashes, calls ISessionRevoker keeping oi_au_id, enqueues PasswordChanged, one SaveChangesAsync. Reissues hs.idp with pwd_at. /connect/authorize rejects a stale stamp.

nodes.label: identitydb
nodes.desc: No migration. credentials.password_hash and updated_at (the stamp); OpenIddictAuthorizations / OpenIddictTokens Status set to revoked; outbox row.

nodes.label: Service Bus
nodes.desc: Outbox relay, at least once. Notification's subscription dispatches by eventType.

nodes.label: Notification
nodes.desc: features/emails becomes a table keyed by event type; PasswordChanged → template password_changed (vi/en, time in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, no link). Payload validated by a pydantic model mirroring the schema.

nodes.label: notificationdb
nodes.desc: No schema change. email_records unique on (event_id, template) makes the email idempotent.

nodes.label: Email provider
nodes.desc: SMTP (Mailpit locally, Resend in the cloud). Sent after commit; a failure is recorded as failed (retries are FEAT-032).

all.title: FEAT-003 design solution
all.intro: Five paths: change the password, wrong current password, policy breach, another session signed out, and the guards.

steps.t: Relay with bearer; Identity verifies the current password and the policy.
One transaction: new argon2id hash, other authorizations and their tokens revoked (current oi_au_id kept), PasswordChanged in the outbox.
Forced session refresh spends the pre-change refresh token; the session continues on a new one (D-3).
Password-changed email in the user's language; a duplicate delivery sends once.
PUT with a wrong or empty current password.
400 common.validation_failed with currentPassword identity.current_password_incorrect (or _required). Hash, sessions and outbox unchanged.
400 listing every unmet rule for newPassword (too short, needs a digit) together with any current-password error. Nothing changes.
Session B keeps its access token until it expires (≤ 15 min, FR-AUTH-015 note).
B's refresh gets invalid_grant: its authorization is revoked. The gateway clears B's cookie.
B signs in again: its old hs.idp has a stale pwd_at, so /connect/authorize sends it to /signin for the new password.
No session → 401 at the gateway; no CSRF header → 403.
Direct call without a valid token → 401; a spoofed X-User-Id never selects the user.
No password on the account (Google-created, FEAT-004) → 409 identity.password_not_set; setting one is FEAT-005.

notes.b: Plan said POST; project rule makes updates PUT. A retried request after success fails on the current password, so the UI never retries.
Tracked status changes on OpenIddict's own tables, committed with the hash and the outbox. Rejected: manager API (saves per call), a deny-list or token version.
The forced refresh spends the pre-change refresh token. Residual: if that request is lost, the token stays redeemable once, held only in this session's own encrypted cookie.
pwd_at = credential updated_at (Unix ms). Without it another browser's 7-day hs.idp would sign it back in silently. Pre-feature cookies stop working once.
Same pattern as UserRegistered; the contacts projection may lag.

notes.t: Shared password field moves to packages/
notes.b: Features cannot import each other; one copy of the client policy hints.
Lockout counting (FR-AUTH-011) and a rate limit arrive with FEAT-005; until then a valid session is required.
The FEAT-003 plan row says POST /v1/me/password; it should read PUT. Owned by implementation-planning.
Set a first password for Google accounts (UC-026 1a, FR-AUTH-027, OQ-33) → FEAT-005; email retries → FEAT-032.
SCR-STF-018 entry points (profile page and/or account menu), success toast copy, and the 409 state.
